title: No production per-session input sequencer
desired_behavior: Inputs for one Managed Agent session execute in accepted order.

title: Slack retry after accepted A2A send can duplicate provider input
desired_behavior: A Slack retry after A2A acceptance must converge on the existing Task without duplicating provider input; ambiguous provider acceptance remains separately tracked by KL-003.

title: Ambiguous controller send can remain held without provider evidence
desired_behavior: A provider idempotency key or authoritative delivery status would let the controller safely retry an unconfirmed send without operator intervention. Controller admins can now inspect and manually fail a hold or retry ambiguous input delivery after external verification that CMA did not accept it.

title: Pinned A2A client stops consuming a stream after an agent Message
desired_behavior: The official client should continue consuming subsequent TaskStatusUpdateEvents after a complete agent Message. The controller emits both events on HTTP+JSON; clients can use GetTask for final status until SDK behavior changes.
